slides.title: A thick mucus layer shields the wall from acid and the enzyme pepsin.
slides.vo: A layer of mucus shields the wall from acid and enzymes.

caption:
Your stomach holds acid strong enough to dissolve protein 🧬 An enzyme called pepsin does the work, and a thick layer of mucus keeps the stomach wall safe from it.
